name: Reka Drava
subtitle: Trbonjsko jezero, od državne meje z Avstrijo do HE Vuzenica

en.name: The river Drava
en.subtitle: from the state border with Austria to the hydropower plant Vuzenica
en.description: The Koroška ribiška družina manages two districts on the river Drava. The district Drava I extends from the state border with Austria to the hydropower plant Dravograd, the district Drava II extends from the hydropower plant Dravograd to the hydropower plant Vuzenica. In the vicinity of hydropower plant Dravograd there is the Črneče bay, where you can fish for carps, tenches, common breams, roaches, common nases.

description: Koroška ribiška družina upravlja na reki Dravi z dvema revirjema. Revir Drava I sega od državne meje z Avstrijo pa do HE Dravograd. Revir Drava II pa od HE Dravograd pa do HE Vuzenica. Nad HE Dravograd je tudi črneški zaliv, v katerem se obeta dober ulov krapov, ploščičev, rdečeok, podusti. Zelo dober pa je tudi lov ščuke, smuča in soma. Prav v Črneškem zalivu je bila ulovljena najtežja ščuka v Sloveniji.

name: Reka Meža
subtitle: od izvira do jezu za KD v Mežici

en.name: The river Meža
en.subtitle: from the spring to Mežica
en.description: The districts Meža 1,2 extend from the spring to the dam behind Kulturni dom in Mežica. You can find mostly brown trouts and graylings there. It is allowed to catch three fish, but only one over 50 cm. The catch of graylings is forbidden. You can use only artificial flies or streamers.

description: Revir Meža 1,2 poteka od izvira do jezu za Kulturnim domom v Mežici. V revirju se nahajata pretežno potočna postrv in lipan. Dovoljene vabe so samo umetna muha ali potezanka.

name: Reka Meža
subtitle: od mostu pri Domu upokojencev Mežica do vodnega rova na Prevaljah

en.name: The river Meža
en.subtitle: from Mežica to Prevalje
en.description: The Meža 3 district extends from the dam behind Dom upokojencev in Mežica to water tunnel in Prevalje. In this district you can mostly find brown trouts and graylings. Allowed catch is 3 pieces of trouts, but only one piece over 50 cm. The catch of graylings is forbidden. The allowed baits are only artificial fly or streamer.

description: Revir Meža 3 poteka od mostu pri Domu upokojencev v Mežici do vodnega rova na Prevaljah. V revirju se nahajata pretežno potočna postrv in lipan. Dovoljene vabe so samo umetna muha ali potezanka.

name: Reka Meža
subtitle: od vodnega rova na Prevaljah do železniškega mostu v Ravnah

en.name: The river Meža
en.subtitle: from Prevalje to Ravne na Koroškem
en.description: The Meža 4 district extends from water tunnel in Prevalje to concrete railway bridge (between Ravne na Koroškem and Dravograd) and there begins the marked trophy district..You can find mostly brown trouts and graylings in this district. The allowed catch of trouts is 3 pieces but only one over 50 cm. The catch of graylings is forbidden. The allowed baits are only an artificial fly or streamer.

description: Revir Meža 4 poteka od vodnega rova na Prevaljah do betonskega železniške mostu (med Dravogradom in Ravnami), kjer se prične označen trofejni revir. V revirju se nahajajo pretežno potočna postrv, šarenka in lipan. Dovoljene vabe so samo umetna muha ali potezanka.

name: Reka Meža
subtitle: Trofejni revir, od železniškega mostu v Ravnah do starega mostu pred sotočjem z Mislinjo

en.name: The river Meža
en.subtitle: Trophy district, from Ravne to the place where the Meža flows into the Mislinja
en.description: In this district only catch and release is valid! It is meant for fishermen who are eager to catch beautiful fish and then release them back into the river. It is allowed to fish using only one fly rod and one artificial fly and hooks without barbs are mandatory.

description: V tem revirju velja izključno režim ujemi-izpusti! Namenjen je ribičem, ki si želijo ujeti lepih kapitalnih primerkov rib in jih potem vrniti v reko. V tem revirju je dovoljen ribolov z eno muharico in eno umetno muho, obvezna pa je uporaba trnka brez zalusti oz. s stisnjeno zalustjo.

name: Reka Meža
subtitle: komercialni revir, od lesenega mostu pred sotočjem z reko Mislinjo do izliva v Dravo

en.name: The river Meža
en.subtitle: commercial district, from where the Meža meets the Mislinja to the Mislinja's outflow into the Drava
en.description: This district is considered as mixed type so basically it is populated only by cyprinids and salmonids. It is meant for commercial purposes only. The fishing is allowed using only one fly rod and one artificial fly and it is desired to use only hooks without barbs or with barbs pressed.

description: Ta revir ima status mešanega revirja, naseljujejo ga ciprinidi in salmonidi. Namenjen je izključno v komercialne namene. Ribolov je dovoljen samo z eno muharico in eno umetno muho, zaželena je uporaba brezzalustnika oz. trnka s stisnjeno zalustjo. Komercialni revir sega od starega lesenega mostu, to je približno 300 m nad sotočjem z reko Mislinjo pa do izliva v reko Dravo. Skupna dolžina revirja je cca. 2 km.

name: Reka Mislinja
subtitle: od izvira do mostu v Šmartnem pri SG

en.name: The river Mislinja
en.subtitle: from the spring to the bridge in Šmartno near Slovenj Gradec
en.description: The district Mislinja1,2 extends from the spring of the Mislinja to the bridge in Šmartno near Slovenj Gradec. You can find mostly brown trout and grayling in this district. It is allowed to catch three trouts, but only one can be over 50 cm long. The catch of grayling is forbidden. The allowed baits are only artificial fly and streamer.

description: Revir Mislinja 1,2 se nahaja od izvira Mislinje do mostu v Šmartnem pri Slovenj Gradcu. V revirju se nahajata pretežno potočna postrv in lipan. Dovoljene vabe so samo umetna muha ali potezanka.
qualityNotes: do: kraj Šmartno pri Slovenj Gradcu

name: Reka Mislinja
subtitle: od mostu v Šmartnem pri Slovenj Gradcu do mostu v Jederti

en.name: The river Mislinja
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Šmartno near Slovenj Gradec to the bridge in Bukovska vas
en.description: The whole district extends from the bridge in Šmartno near Slovenj Gradec to the bridge in Jedert ( the bridge across the Mislinja on the main road). Mostly brown trouts and graylings can be found here. The allowed catch is three trouts, but only one over 50 cm. The take of grayling is forbidden. The allowed baits are only artificial fly or streamer.

description: Celoten revir poteka od mostu v Šmartnem pri Slovenj Gradcu do mostu v Jederti (most glavne ceste čez Mislinjo). V revirju se nahajata pretežno potočna postrv in lipan. Dovoljene vabe so samo umetna muha ali potezanka.
qualityNotes: samo ena meja: kraj Slovenj Gradec

name: Reka Mislinja
subtitle: od mostu glavne ceste v Jederti do sotočja z reko Mežo

en.name: The river Mislinja
en.subtitle: from the bridge in Bukovska vas to the outflow into the Meža
en.description: The district Mislinja extends from the bridge across the main road in Jedert to confluence with the Meža. You can mostly find brown trouts, rainbow trouts and graylings here. It is allowed to catch three trouts but only one over 50 cm. The catch of grayling is forbidden. The allowed baits are only artificial fly or streamer.

description: Revir Mislinja poteka od mostu glavne ceste v Jederti do sotočja z reko Mežo. V revirju se nahaja pretežno potočna postrv, šarenka in lipan. Dovoljen ulov je 3 kom postrvi od tega je dovoljen uplen samo ene postrvi nad 50 cm. Dovoljene vabe so samo umetna muha ali potezanka.

name: Ribnik Brdinje

en.name: The pond Brdinje
en.description: Between Ravne and Kotlje there is the pond Brdinje, which is owned by the Koroška ribiška družina and is over 12.000 m2 big.You can find approximately two tons of fish in the pond; from carps, tenches, common nases, Danube roaches, chubs, some small fish to some first class pikes.The location of the pond is extremely beautiful and it makes the Koroška ribiška družina very proud.

description: Med Ravnami in Kotljami se razprostira Ribnik Brdinje, last Koroške ribiške družine, v izmeri nad 12.000 m2 površine. V ribniku se nahajata približno dve toni rib, od krapov, linjev, podusti, platnic, klenov, drobiža, in nekaj kapitalnih ščuk. Ribnik je na zelo lepi lokaciji in je ponos Koroške ribiške družine. Ribolov je na voljo članom Koroške ribiške družine in ostalim ribičem (turistom).

name: Reka Suhodolnica

en.name: The river Suhodolnica
en.description: The river Suhodolnica is the main source of drinking water for the Slovenj Gradec basin due to its extra clear upper stream. Even the endangered species can be found here, especially freshwater crayfish. The bottom is lime and stone. The river creates numerous pools in its lower course as well as smaller rapids where brown and brook trouts live.

description: Reka Suhadolnica predstavlja glavni vir pitne vode za Slovenjegraško kotlino, kar pomeni, da je reka v zgornjem delu izredno čista. V tem delu reku lahko najdemo celo ogroženega potočnega raka. Struktura tal je apnenčasta in kamnita. Reka v svojem spodnjem toku ustvarja številne tolmune ter manjše brzice, v katerih plavajo potočne ter ameriške postrvi.
